about.heading: About Me
about.summary: Senior Front-End Developer with 9+ years building production web applications for international clients across the US, UK, Sweden, and Brazil. Deep expertise in the React (Next.js, Redux, GraphQL) and Angular (NgRx/NGXS, RxJS) ecosystems, with hands-on experience architecting features from scratch, leading front-end teams, and shipping AI-driven functionality. Comfortable owning a codebase end-to-end — from architecture decisions and code-quality standards to mentoring and cross-team review.
